We need number of C=O groups. IR spectrum shows peaks; carbonyl typically around 1700 cm-1 (C=O stretch). The given wavenumbers: 3407 (OH/NH), 3045-2927 (C-H), 2356, 2221, 1511, 1507. No peak near 1700. There is 2356 (maybe CO2), 2221 (C≡N or alkyne). No carbonyl. So answer 0.

But ensure no hidden carbonyl maybe at 1710 not listed. The IR data limited. Could also use carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbon ~200 ppm. Could check carbon NMR but not needed if IR shows none. However to be safe, maybe check carbon NMR for carbonyl signals. Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool.
